  arr: array[int]
  i: int
  j: int
Assumptions:
  h_precond: swap_precond(arr, i, j)
Find result: array[int]
such that swap_postcond(arr, i, j, result, h_precond)
spec:
def swap_postcond(arr: array[int], i: int, j: int, result: array[int], h_precond: swap_precond(arr, i, j)) =
  size(result) == size(arr) and result[to_nat_of(i)] == arr[to_nat_of(j)] and result[to_nat_of(j)] == arr[to_nat_of(i)] and (forall (k: nat): k < size(arr) ==> k != to_nat_of(i) ==> k != to_nat_of(j) ==> result[k] == arr[k])

goal:
Inputs:
  X: int
  Y: int
Assumptions:
  h_precond: SwapSimultaneous_precond(X, Y)
Find result: tuple[int, int]
such that SwapSimultaneous_postcond(X, Y, result, h_precond)
spec:
def SwapSimultaneous_postcond(X: int, Y: int, result: tuple[int, int], h_precond: SwapSimultaneous_precond(X, Y)) =
  result.1 == Y and result.2 == X and (X != Y ==> result.fst != X and result.snd != Y)

goal:
Inputs:
  a: array[int]
  j: nat
Assumptions:
  h_precond: TestArrayElements_precond(a, j)
Find result: array[int]
such that TestArrayElements_postcond(a, j, result, h_precond)
spec:
def TestArrayElements_postcond(a: array[int], j: nat, result: array[int], h_precond: TestArrayElements_precond(a, j)) =
  size(result) == size(a) and result[j] == 60 and (forall k: k < size(a) ==> k != j ==> result[k] == a[k])

goal:
Inputs:
  x: int
Assumptions:
  h_precond: Triple_precond(x)
Find result: int
such that Triple_postcond(x, result, h_precond)
spec:
def Triple_postcond(x: int, result: int, h_precond: Triple_precond(x)) =
  result / 3 == x and result / 3 * 3 == result
